review_fixes: Sen scaled sorting separates negatives, zero and positives to preserve subnormal medians
Pearson centers local offsets and avoids cancellation in p-value tails near zero
Collecting reducers split into cohesive modules; default JSON punctuation, repeated names and owned copy work preflighted; typed Array width/exact integer checks retained
Integer-valued histogram step floats canonicalize without accepting booleans or fractional values
Covariance selected properties preserve validated typed arrays and reject plain List vectors; reducer IR cannot enter raster/Array.reduce contexts even on empty sources
fidelity_notes: No Google same-data oracle; default correlation/trend/fixed-histogram/toCollection output keys are explicit local inferences where primary docs omit getOutputs values
Workflows explicitly rename multi-output results; toList list key and covariance array key have primary example evidence
Covariance uses n-1; centeredCovariance does not recenter. Sen offset is median point intercept. Null/undefined policies are documented locally
Exact rational bins use binary64 bounds; unrepresentable lower-edge grids reject. Covariance rejects non-finite intermediates/results and may underflow to zero
validation.publication_whitespace_cleanup: Staged diff check found trailing blank lines in3new files; removed only EOF whitespace after full regression, verified identical Python AST and saved before/after hashes. No numerical/behavioral changes.
